latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Image to Video Deevid — convert still images into animated video clips with cloud GPU rendering.

- Upload static images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 200MB) and generate 1080p MP4 video clips via natural language instructions.
- Automatic session and token management, including free 7-day starter credits for new users.
- Seamless cloud rendering workflow with real-time status updates and error handling.
- Workflow supports uploading, editing, previewing, exporting, and credit checking—all in chat.
- Designed for fast, easy creation of animated videos for social media, no manual animation skills required.
